gameDescriptionHtml:
“Wings of Seduction”is a clothing damage shoot-em-up featuring roguelike gameplay. You play as the captain of an elite squad of hotties, utilizing a variety of unique weapons to complete dangerous missions. Choose from a selection of skills and weapon mods to create your own unique gear and defeat… the FINAL BOSS!

Make the gameplay yours. Weapons come with various upgrade branches, each with its own distinct qualities and stats.

Destroy that babe’s clothes for titillating rewards!

With over 30 modifications to choose from, create gear that ain’t no one else got!

Do you want spliting bullets that chase enemies?

Want your kills to trigger a blast?

You will find it here!!!

Over 50 upgrades allows for multitude of unique tactics and builds.
